title: Queenstown for first-timers
dek: A calm two-day outline before adventure operators fill the calendar.

hero.alt: Soft morning light on a New Zealand harbour shoreline promenade

body: Day one: walk the lake edge early, then keep the afternoon free for a short trail with clear weather windows.
Day two: explore the town centre on foot and note stay neighbourhoods you may search later — without treating placeholder modules as live inventory.

seo.title: Queenstown first-timer guide
seo.description: A practical first visit outline for Queenstown that never invents prices or availability.
